title: Prime Minister pays tributes to Sree Narayana Guru on his birth anniversary
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, paid tributes to Sree Narayana Guru on his birth anniversary, today. Shri Modi described Sree Narayana Guru as a towering social reformer, spiritual leader and thinker who devoted his life to building a society rooted in dignity and compassion.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
Tributes to Sree Narayana Guru on his birth anniversary!
A towering social reformer, spiritual leader and thinker, he devoted his life to building a society rooted in dignity and compassion. His thoughts gave strength to countless people. Equally noteworthy was his focus on education and learning.

enrichment.summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tributes to Sree Narayana Guru on his birth anniversary via a post on X. He described the social reformer as a towering figure devoted to building a society based on dignity and compassion, highlighting his emphasis on education and learning.
enrichment.context:
Sree Narayana Guru (1856-1928) was a prominent social reformer and spiritual leader from Kerala who campaigned against caste discrimination and untouchability, famously coining the phrase 'One Caste, One Religion, One God for Mankind.' He founded the Sree Narayana Dharma Paripalana (SNDP) Yogam to promote social and educational upliftment of the Ezhava community and other backward sections, and established temples open to all castes, most notably at Aruvippuram, challenging Brahminical orthodoxy. His reform movement is considered a key part of India's broader socio-religious reform movements of the 19th-20th centuries, alongside figures like Jyotirao Phule and B.R. Ambedkar, that laid groundwork for social justice movements in modern India.

This release is a routine ceremonial tribute by the Prime Minister on a reformer's birth anniversary, without any new policy announcement, scheme, or substantive government action attached to it.
